verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a Stats API for delivery, open, and click statistics, a Bounce API and bounce webhook, and open and link tracking. That covers bounce and engagement analytics. A paid DMARC monitoring add-on and DKIM/SPF/Return-Path verification add some authentication and reputation signals. Nothing in the pack goes beyond these counts and authentication checks to offer inbox-placement or sender-reputation guidance, which is the story's core ask. missing for 10: explicit spam-complaint analytics, inbox placement insights or seed testing, sender reputation scoring or guidance, interpretive recommendations beyond raw counts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
